explanation: For each digit, try every mapped character and recursively extend the mnemonic. Digits 0 and 1 each contribute their own character.
timeComplexity: O(n · M), where M is the number of mnemonics (at most 4^n).
spaceComplexity: O(n) working space, plus O(n · M) output.
attribution: JavaScript port of the independently authored EPI Practice C# algorithm; no upstream reference code copied.
